pairs.why: A has the chunky, saturated, rounded cartoon build of the taxi card, while B's white box rover looks plain and sterile, like a plastic product render.
The two are nearly identical, but A's treaded wheels, vents and crisper panel detail look slightly more like a built object, while B is a touch softer and plainer.
A's treaded wheels and jointed suspension look built like a real rover, while B's smooth rubbery toy wheels drift toward the glossy toy look the lessons rejected.
A is a chunky, readable cowboy boot with pull straps, a stitched flame overlay and warm saturated shading like the real icons, while B is a plain stretched tube with odd proportions.
A has believable boot construction and rich color, while B's smooth seamless cylinder shaft, star spur and pale washed background look less built and less like the cards.
B is built like the real barrel card (tall staves, iron hoops, a wood floor scene), while A's pot-like lid knob and squat body make it look like a toy jar.
B swings ultra-smooth and flat with a washed-out pale scene, while A keeps the saturated painted wood finish of the real cards despite its odd lid knob.
